newsitem.title: USA: NY sees faster electricity demand growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: NY sees faster electricity demand growth in 1997.

text.p: New York state's electricity consumption is projected to grow about 3 percent this year after increasing an estimated 2 percent in 1996, Governor George E. Pataki's budget message said.
Consumption of natural gas is expected to drop from unusually high 1996 levels, the budget projected, estimating that natural gas demand increased about 6 percent last year.
"The price of electricity is projected to rise less than 1 percent (this year) and the price of natural gas is expected to rise between 1 and 2 percent."
The governor noted "Natural gas prices have recovered from relatively low 1995 levels. The price of electricity increased by less than 1 percent" in 1996.
